comment: Annotations use model labels and provided table mapping. RAS family expanded to KRAS/HRAS/NRAS; SOS expanded to SOS1/SOS2. Phosphorylated states are returned as the base protein names (post-translational state preserved by species identity but canonical protein names given). Distinct molecular components only are listed for multimeric complexes.
